column1: # note: The New York State tax rate schedule (page 33). It gives line 39 when New York AGI is $107,650 or less and taxable income is $65,000 or more; the tax computation worksheets on pages 34 to 39 start from it when AGI is more.
# note: Married filing jointly and qualifying surviving spouse share one schedule, as do single and married filing separately; each is repeated for both.
# note: The instructions enter whole dollars, rounding cents to the nearest dollar (page 2).
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
